discovered_at.description: When the organisation became aware of the incident, ISO 8601. A value with no offset is read as Australia/Sydney.

facts.description: Incident facts. Booleans such as cyber_security_incident, personal_information_involved, serious_harm_ruled_out, eligible_breach_believed, soci_part_2b_applies, significant_availability_impact, relevant_impact, ransomware_payment_made, apra_material_incident, apra_control_weakness, notified_other_regulator, significant_cyber_security_incident. Times payment_at and oral_report_at. Text such as summary, impact and systems_affected for the draft fields. Leave a fact out when it is not known.

org.description: org.yaml fields (sector, turnover, regulators, critical_infrastructure, holds_personal_information, name). Leave out to read org.yaml from the profile.

now.description: Time to count down from. Leave out for no countdown.
